items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: I have made a record with Joe Robichaux. And Joe Robichaux and I, we've been all in Texas, County, Texas.

ctx.x: I was wondering, it seems like somebody told me maybe your brother or somebody thought you'd made some records with Joe Robichaux. Do you remember? I did.

I did. That's right. That's what I say. After you would... After you leave, I could recall and I have made a record with Joe Robichaux. And Joe Robichaux and I, we've been all in Texas, County, Texas. And we had some nice engagements up there.
Where did you make the records with Joe Robichaux?
